name: usage-context
description: Per-turn token-usage chips for ZCode, shown in each assistant turn's footer right of the timestamp: 'Usage N tok' and 'Ran for Ns'. Hovering either chip opens a panel with the full breakdown ZCode records for that turn (total, cache hit %, uncached input, cached input, output, provider/model, steps). Reads turn_usage data from the stats-composer sidecar (one shared server, no second process of its own).

showChips.title: Show per-turn chips
showChips.description: Render the 'Usage N tok' and 'Ran for Ns' chips in each assistant turn footer.

showRanFor.title: Show the 'Ran for' chip
showRanFor.description: Also render the elapsed-time chip. Turn it off to keep only the token chip.

sidecarPort.title: stats-composer sidecar port
sidecarPort.description: Port of the stats-composer sidecar that serves per-turn usage on /turn. This plugin reads that endpoint instead of opening the usage DB itself, so only one server ever runs.

port.title: Unused port slot
port.description: Kept distinct from stats-composer's 7427 on purpose. This plugin does not bind a port (it reuses stats-composer's server); the value exists only so a future standalone mode cannot silently collide with 7427.
